Subject: Performance proofing: mutual 'proof of performance' run & evidence package

Hi Alex / Michelle —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our call, we'd like to run a mutually-observed performance "proof" with the HelioBank team to validate latency/throughput targets before we sign off on production rollout. I attached a short proof-run plan and a mutual action plan to make coordination easier.

High-level acceptance criteria (proposed):
- Latency: p99 < 800 ms for 512-token completion, p95 < 450 ms
- Throughput: sustained 40 requests/sec for 10 minutes at 95% success rate (200 OK)
- Cold-start/warm-up: 5-minute warm-up prior to measurement window
- Quality gate: sample prompt set (attached) must match expected top-1 behavior; no regression > 3% on key prompts

Suggested schedule:
- Wednesday 2027-05-12, 10:00–11:30 PT — joint run + results playback

Requested from HelioBank for the run:
- Primary test contact (who will trigger traffic)
- Any network egress constraints / IP allowlisting needed for our agents
- Confirmation test region: us-east-1 (preferred)

I've cc'd Dev (infrastructure lead) and Marcus (CS lead) — they'll run the harness, collect logs, and produce the evidence package (load profile, raw logs, aggregated metrics, artifacts).

Attachments: proof-run-plan.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.md, traffic-matrix.json

Next steps: please confirm the proposed time and the two test contacts we should expect.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager

Alex / Laura —

Thanks — quick technical reply from our side with the harness specifics so you can prep:

Planned harness and ramp profile (attached): load-script.k6.js
- Warm-up: linear ramp from 1 -> 20 VUs over 5 minutes (to populate KV cache)
- Ramp: ramp to 80 VUs over 6 minutes, then hold 50 VUs for 10 minutes measurement window
- Target concurrency correlates to ~40 req/s steady for our model configuration (512-token avg)

Test tool: k6 with our custom runner that tags every request with run-id and increments a unique session-id (so we can dedupe). We'll provide the k6 script and a small helper container image for Helio to run if desired.

Evidence we will deliver after the run:
- Aggregated metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, error rates)
- Token-level cost breakdown, token counts, and per-request CPU/GPU usage snapshots
- Raw request logs & KV cache hit-rate timeline
- Results packaged as results-template.csv + a short deliverable deck

Endpoint for log upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-helio-perf-evidence (we'll share a folder with write access for the run window).

Command example (for Helio agent):
- docker run --rm -e K6_OPTS='-u 50 -d 00:16:00' redwood/k6-runner:latest load-script.k6.js

If Helio wants us to initiate the traffic from our prod-adjacent agents, let us know and we'll provide IP ranges for allowlisting.

Attachments: load-script.k6.js, results-template.csv

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai

Quick heads up on constraints from procurement/security:
- Test region must be us-east-1 only (we can not sign off on cross-region runs)

Also, we have a strict egress allowlist. Our infra team will share two IPs today for allowlisting; please confirm the port ranges your harness needs (we usually allow 443 only).

Thanks — Michelle
